best_for: Hobby developers and students on Windows who need to watch, replay or fake HTTP and HTTPS traffic for a personal project, and who do not need it at work.
description:
Fiddler Classic is a web debugging proxy for Windows from Progress Software, sold under its Telerik brand. It sits between your apps and the internet and records every HTTP and HTTPS request that passes through it.

It is not limited to the browser. Telerik's guides show how to route traffic from .NET, Java and PHP apps, and from Android and iOS phones, through the PC that runs Fiddler. You can turn on HTTPS decryption to read secure traffic in plain text, watch another computer on your network, pass traffic on to an upstream proxy, or run Fiddler as a reverse proxy in front of a local web server. Traffic over a VPN or to localhost can be captured too, with a few extra steps.

points.title: Non-commercial use only
points.text: Since August 3, 2026, Fiddler Classic is licensed for non-commercial use only. Using it for a job or a client means buying Fiddler Everywhere instead.

points.title: What the paid option costs
points.text: Fiddler Everywhere Lite is listed at USD 7 per user per month billed yearly, Pro at USD 13 and Enterprise at USD 37, with monthly billing at USD 10 and USD 19 for Lite and Pro. It runs on Windows, macOS and Linux. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: The classic toolkit still works
points.text: It logs and inspects HTTP and HTTPS traffic on Windows, lets you build requests by hand in the Composer, and serves mock responses with the AutoResponder. Testing an app against a broken API no longer needs a broken server.

points.title: Maintenance mode
points.text: Telerik describes Classic as in maintenance mode, with community support only and no promise of new releases, patches or help. Newer protocol work such as HTTP/2 and gRPC goes into Fiddler Everywhere.

points.title: Windows only, per-user install
points.text: There is no Mac or Linux build. The installer comes in x86 and x64 and installs for the current user. This site keeps 11 Windows versions.
